title: Custom Iterator Protocol
prompt:
Implement __iter__ and __next__ for a custom countdown iterator.

Starting code:

class Countdown:
    def __init__(self, start):
        self.current = start
    
    def ___(self):
        return self
        
    def __next__(self):
        if self.current == 0:
            raise StopIteration
        self.current -= 1
        return self.current + 1

title: Data Descriptor Protocol
prompt:
Implement a descriptor class with __get__ and __set__.

Starting code:

class PositiveNumber:
    def __set_name__(self, owner, name):
        self.name = name
        
    def ___(self, instance, owner=None):
        return instance.__dict__.get(self.name, 0)
        
    def __set__(self, instance, value):
        if value < 0:
            raise ValueError("Must be positive")
        instance.__dict__[self.name] = value

title: Object Creation (__new__)
prompt:
Override __new__ to implement a Singleton pattern.

Starting code:

class Singleton:
    _instance = None
    
    def ___(cls, *args, **kwargs):
        if cls._instance is None:
            cls._instance = super().__new__(cls)
        return cls._instance
